text: I write down their number. Someone should.
My brother would like this inn. He liked any place with a fire.
Round fifty. I have run out of pages.
My eyes hurt. My hands do not care.
Papers. Their papers. I keep everything they write.
Twelve. It's the twenty-fourth. Wigilia. Somewhere my mother is looking at the first star.
Głodny, Dutch. You just told me you are a hungry woman.
Dziękuję. Not jen-koo-yeh. Your grandmother must have wept.
That is not a swear. You just said 'bright plague.' Fine. It works.
Thank you. I will write you in the notebook. The good page.
The pilot's seat. Empty. No tracks in the snow around the nose. Write that down. ...I am writing that down.
...Pan Ostrowski. From the end of the lane. You had a dog with one ear.
Tomek. You saw Tomek.
He wrote that. That he practised on the rats. That he still missed.
...Thank you for looking.
Then if I ever see a backwards hook, I'll know it's his.
KB... four-four-seven-one.
I'm writing it in the book. On the good page.
It's his. Tomek's. It was in the tank room. With the... with the others.
He was a terrible shot, Dutch. I used to tell him he'd starve if he had to hunt alone. And they put him in a tank.
I was too late.
...Za duszę. For the soul. You said it right. First time.
The bell. My brother wrote that the walls hum. This is louder.
Fog. Lanterns. Those were miners. Shoot them anyway.
Fire, and I am still here. Good beer.
The brandy. My eye is clear. Into the book.
The stout is still in me. Hit me. They will see.
I can run forever. I ran here from Kraków, almost.
Lightning from my rifle. I will not write how.
Three guns. More marks in the notebook.
A name. They had names, once.
Schnapps. Quick hands for lifting. Good.
Reload, fast. The tonic is still in my fingers.
Faster. The gun is hungry tonight.
A crate that robs the poor. How German.
I could kill more with a sharpened spoon.
The drummer. Reinholt's girl's toy. It is following us.
Run, little soldier. One day I will catch you.
Good. Finally, something here is on our side.
This will do. This will do very well.
Crawling. Like they made my brother crawl.
Their furnace. Their glass. Our gun now.
It changed the rifle. I don't want to know how.
Reinholt's daughter's music box. She had a child. I had a brother.
Four bells. Shoot them in order. Like counting.
Break the heart. Break all of it.
Not my rifle. But it's learning.
Sights right, grip right. Now it only has to be honest.
The soldier. He is standing. Do not look at his face. Shoot.
Ostrowski. From Wilcza Góra. ...I know your face. I was a girl.
East. The rail line. It goes to the salt works. I know that line.
That other voice. Cheerful. On his frequency. That was not Fasbender.
He says Gravelight. He knows the plane. Someone was waiting for us.
A man alone, calling and calling. He has been doing this a while.
Kaltenbrunn. The salt works. My brother's letters came from there.
It hums, he says. Tomasz wrote of a hum. Then he stopped writing.
The innkeeper listened to the works' channels. He wrote them down. Look for the notes.
Paper. Small, with numbers. The whole house, not just this room.
A note. Frequency and a number. I keep it.
Here. Written fast, but numbered. He knew someone would come.
First of three. I can feel it. The others are hidden the same way.
Two. The last one is close. Nothing here is far.
Three. Now the radio. One, two, three, in order. A wrong one makes noise, and noise brings them.
We have all of it. Behind the bar. I will read, someone turns.
The cabinets. Open. All of them. A gift from a voice we don't know.
Wrong. Again, from the first note. Quickly, they come.
No. The first number. Then the second. They heard that.
Peg will be jealous. Or she already drank three.
Bitter. Good. Now I see where they hide things.
It shows me the clock on every gift. Nothing here is free. I knew that.
I hate that this works. I hate it.
Sniper brandy, made by the men who hunted us. My hands are steadier. Damn them.
Bavarian beer. Thick as their heads.
I could run to Kraków. I would, if this were done.
My rifle hums when it is empty. Fine. Let it sing.
Static in the blood. My brother would have laughed at this.
One more weapon. One more chance.
Not yet. Not today.
Siostra Agnieszka. She was real. She nursed the laborers. Thank you, sister. (Sister Agnieszka.)
She made this to keep them alive. They used it to keep them working.
More. It always wants you to have more.
The owl on the glass. Somebody here was on our side.
Fizz. My hands are fast now. Faster than theirs.
Bitter. Appropriate.
They wrote down who made it. They never write down who it was made from.
A furnace that teaches guns. Of course they built that before bread.
Power. The laborers built that switch. Now we use it.
Finished. Reload. Do not relax.
Quiet. It will not last. It never does.
They come. Count them.
Again. Good. I have pages left.
Kaltenbrunn. Six kilometers from home. Good. Then I know the way out.
Rifle, book, pencil. I am ready.
Sześćdziesiąt... I am losing count. Good. (Sixty.)
Keep them coming. The notebook is hungry.
A terrible shot. A good laugh.
He would have liked you. He liked everyone. It was his only flaw.
Is that about me?
Finish it. Then never sing it again.
In church. Before.
Głodny. You are a man.
God help Poland.
Every one.
It is a lot of Germans.
Dziękuję. You thank me like a man chewing gravel.
Then Babcia chewed gravel.
I know.
Neither is lying. Unlike SOE.
When this is done, I will still be Polish. London will not fix that.
Thirty-two. You missed the one in the fog.
You talk to the machines.
Do they talk back?
Your machine. Hattie. She is loud.
Then I am very alive tonight.
Your grandmother. Where was she from?
...Six kilometers from here.
How many tonight?
Thirty-one. I count for you.
You did not come for Fasbender.
That is not an answer.
Your orders. Do they say to bring us out?
I asked about us.
Few rounds left.
Empty. Do diabła. (To the devil.)
Window closed.
Ammunition. The only thing here worth the price.
This is Peg's kind of gun. I will borrow her taste.
Heavy. Loud. Everything I am not.
A shovel. Good. I will dig them a proper place.
A pistol. For when I want to be close. I never want to be close.
Mauser. Their rifle. Their bullets. Their heads. Fair.
Gewehr. Semi-automatic. I can be efficient.
Shotgun. For people who cannot aim. Today, that is me.
A machine pistol. Inelegant. Useful.
Fasbender's toy. Built in the same place as my brother's grave.
I drink. Fine.
I bring it.
I follow.
I hold. They come, I count them.
The door. Yes.
Boards. Yes.
Nobody stays on the floor. Not here.
I save.
Yes. We run them.
Go. I watch.
Crate moved.
Enough. A sniper does not drink four bottles.
No current. The machine sleeps.
Too little Scrip. Later.
Open. I know what's behind this one. I wish I didn't.
Yes. I do it.
I carry it. Cover me.
I find them. You hold the windows.
I bring them.
I stand here. Nobody passes.
I do the machine.
Good. Send them here.
I see it. One shot.
My key. Tell me when.
No. Not now.
Not found yet. Show me.
We do not know it yet. I don't guess.
This can go wrong. You say, I do.
You are busy. I do the last one.
Done.
Ready. The last one is yours.
Wait. Fight first.
This is yours. I watch.
One more.
Again. Good.
Back to it.
Now again.
You must be here for this.
Jeden. (One.)
Clean. Into the book.
That is how it is done, Dutch.
Yes.
I go.
I buy it. My Scrip.
Yes. I buy.
I hold there.
I buy one for you.
I go there.
Coming.
Now I have enough. I go.
Done.
Full again.
Pistol is better now.
Blastproof. Good.
Crate. We see.
In the fire. Cover me.
Door is open.
Bought.
Hawkeye. Now I see everything.
Ironhide. Good.
Marathon Malt. I run.
Overclock. It burns.
Packmule. One more rifle.
Second Wind. I lift you faster.
Trap is on.
Trigger Tonic. Fast hands.
Twin Barrel. Two.
No. Cannot.
No more bottles.
My guns are better. No.
I have it.
No power.
No way there.
Power. On.
Not enough. I stop.
At your feet. Take.
For you. Take it from me.
Back to it.
Again. Back to it.
Not enough Scrip. Wait.
Need 100 more. I earn it.
Need 1,000 more. I earn it.
Need 1,250 more. I earn it.
Need 1,500 more. I earn it.
Need 200 more. I earn it.

Need 5,000 more. I earn it.

Blackout. Here.
Clearance. The crate is cheap.
Death's Door. Here.
Double Scrip. Here.
Fortify. Here.
Resupply. Here.
Bottle. Here.
There. Something fell. Take it.
All of them. At once. If only it were so easy outside.
The crate is cheap. Move.
Everything dies in one shot. Like a good shot should.
Double. My notebook will need more pages.
Windows closed. Do not waste it.
Ammunition. Count it later.
A gift. Nothing here is a gift. Drink anyway.
Empty. One moment.
Get up. I am not losing anyone else here.
Up. Shoot. Complain later.
I've got you. Hold on. Hold on.
One hundred. I write it down.
One hundred fifty.
Two hundred. For my brother.
Twenty-five.
Three hundred. Still counting.
Fifty. I am counting.
The lever. Stand back, or join them.
Board's up!
Jakub. ...He breathes. Leave him. He has walked out of worse places than this.
Reloading!
Burning, losing height, same bearing we came in on. I'm writing down the time.
No violet light this time. Only flak. ...That is almost a comfort.
I'm down. Quickly. Quickly!
Tomek... I'm sorry. I came too late.
Big one. Coming now.
The overseer. Obersteiger. My brother worked under him. Let me.
The drill core. Aim there. I want him to know who killed him.
Glass body. Head only. That is all I aim for anyway.
Upstairs. The civilian is turning. Do not wait for them to look at you.
Bad place. Stay away.
Not there. Danger.
The nurse. Kill her. Kill her now.
Behind you. Fast.
You are down. Stay down, shoot low. I come.
One of us is on the floor. Cover me.
Window. Open. There.
